summary.text: Rolling fall cliff is a super resource point of Grand Swine grotto-heaven, home to jumping pigs that break through into deadly fat pigs.

claims.text: Grand Swine grotto-heaven’s two super resource points are rolling fall cliff and pin tree snowfield. Rolling fall cliff holds a large number of desolate beast jumping pigs. Those beasts cannot walk and can only jump. When they grow large and fat enough, they move to the tallest cliff and jump down.

A majestic waterfall flows down the cliff. Its water boils with fire path and water path dao marks and throws off hot steam all year. When jumping pigs enter that waterfall, about one tenth die from the corrosion of those dao marks, and the rest take severe burns and fractures from the fall. Survivors break through into deadly fat pigs, ancient desolate beasts rather than ordinary desolate beasts. The cliff’s yearly scale of deadly fat pigs is number one in the five regions and two heavens.

Yu Zi lists rolling fall cliff among known super resource points in the sovereign immortal aperture, together with triple sacred mountain, divine needle valley, frost dragon pond, pin tree snowfield, water spider sea, and heavenly crystal storage pool.
